results.content: # Optical Fibers and Sensors for Medical Diagnostics, Treatment, and Environmental Applications XXVI. This work presents a novel single-fiber probe combining optical coherence tomography (OCT) for distance sensing and fiber Bragg grating (FBG) technology for contact force measurement in a unified, co-axial design. Infrared fiber-optic sensors for PFAS detection and analysis in complex water matrices. We developed a fiber optics-based Surface-Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy (SERS) sensor for rapid detection and differentiation of live and dead Salmonella in turkey rinsate. Advanced fiber-optic technology combined with multimodal spectroscopy is enabling real-time, non-invasive analysis in industrial and biomedical settings. Advanced ethanol detection via gold nanostars-based optical fiber sensor in a microfluidic platform. This work highlights the effectiveness of combining microfluidics, nanostructured gold materials, and D-shaped optical fibers to create compact, reliable, and highly sensitive ethanol sensors with potential applications in various industries. A yeast-based chemo-optical sensor integrated with cladding-removed plastic optical fiber (POF) is developed for detecting heavy metal ions in water.
